title: S. Korea holds emergency security meeting on N. Korea's missile launch

blocks.text: South Korea’s presidential National Security Office has held an emergency meeting to discuss North Korea’s firing of a ballistic missile, Cheong Wa Dae said Saturday. The NSO said the North’s firing of a ballistic missile is in violation of U.N. Security Council resolutions and urged Pyongyang to immediately stop such provocative action. North Korea fired at least one ballistic missile, Seoul’s military said Saturday, a day after Pyongyang called the South “despicable” for demanding an apology over a blast in the demilitarized zone that wounded three of its soldiers.
